marta: Quick sync: propose an adaptive rewind for AB ramps that minimizes cache churn and prevents flip-flop. core ideas: single decision-aggregator, cache_warmth metric, and soft vs hard rewind modes.
pranav: +1. aggregator must ingest prioritized signals (infra_critical, error_spike, eval_drift, latency_p95) and emit health_score + recommended_rewind_mode. routers only follow controller outputs.
sam: Controller should support soft_rewind (step back one ramp), staged_rewind (fractional decrement), hard_rewind (instant revert). implement soft_rewind first.
jen: Add hysteresis_count and cooldown_s to avoid oscillation. console needs override + forced-rewind with reason.
emily: Define cache_warmth = KV_hit_rate + prefix_reuse metric; low warmth => prefer slower ramp down. emit audit event with full signal payload on any auto-rewind.
rollout-bot: schema-note: rollout-controller v3 required for new enums and cache_warmth gauge.
marta: Action items: prana add infra signals + schema PR; sam prototype soft_rewind sim; jen mock UI; emily dashboard & runbook. follow-up tomorrow 11:00.
